main.description: Looks up one published vocabulary tag by full DID-authority AT-URI and returns its unchanged record with publisher details; authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full AT-URI of the vocabulary-tag record, using a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid, targets another collection, or query parameters are unsupported.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed vocabulary tag exists at this AT-URI.

errors.name: VocabTagQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed tag or required publisher lookup failed; retry after checking the HappyView PostgreSQL service.
